relations.statement: No additive map clones all of |0>,|1>,|+>,|-> (finite qubit linear-algebraic form of claim iii over Q(i))
relations.hypotheses: additive map on qubit states over Q(i)

lemmas.statement: No additive map clones all four Pauli eigenstates |0>,|1>,|+>,|-> over Q(i). This is the finite qubit shadow of source claim (iii) only.

near_misses.claim: cloneZ clones the Z eigenstates, so it would clone the full Z union X set
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Linearity/additivity: cloneZ sends |+> to a Bell-like entangled state rather than |+>|+>, so it fails on the X eigenstates.
